name: Warden
about: Shapes the fight. Plants totems that fight for you and roots enemies in place.

E.name: Totem
E.about: Plant a totem at the mouse. It fights with your weapon, 1.5x as fast: Strikes the toughest foe in 12 m (2.5x your Strike), or Sweeps when 2+ are close (1.25x your Sweep). Up to 3 at once, 20s each.

F.name: Root Field
F.about: Enemies in a circle at the mouse are held in place.
